name: Anterior Atlas
tagline: Anterior Segment and External Eye Disease
description: A 15-episode series covering the conjunctiva, sclera, eyelids, and lacrimal system — the everyday anterior segment conditions optometrists manage.

episodes.title: Conjunctival Anatomy and the Patterns of Redness That Localise Disease
episodes.description: How the pattern of injection (diffuse, localised, ciliary) narrows the differential, and the tarsal vs bulbar conjunctiva exam with lid eversion.

episodes.title: Viral Conjunctivitis: Adenovirus, Epidemic Keratoconjunctivitis, and Contagion
episodes.description: The EKC presentation, the subepithelial infiltrates, the infection control measures, and when the patient can return to work.

episodes.title: Bacterial Conjunctivitis: When to Culture and When to Treat Empirically
episodes.description: The hyperacute (gonococcal) vs acute vs chronic bacterial conjunctivitis, the culture indications, and the antibiotic selection.

episodes.title: Allergic Conjunctivitis: SAC, PAC, AKC, and VKC Management
episodes.description: The four allergic conjunctivitis types, the mast-cell stabiliser vs antihistamine vs dual-action drop selection, and the VKC shield ulcer risk.

episodes.title: Episcleritis vs Scleritis: The Critical Distinction and the Systemic Workup
episodes.description: The blanching of episcleritis with phenylephrine, the pain of scleritis, and the systemic autoimmune workup for true scleritis.

episodes.title: Subconjunctival Hyphema and the Traumatic Red Eye
episodes.description: When a subconjunctival haemorrhage is benign vs when it signals globe rupture (360-degree haemorrhage), and the urgent CT indication.

episodes.title: Pterygium Surgery: Indications, Conjunctival Autograft, and Recurrence
episodes.description: The visual axis and induced astigmatism indications, the bare sclera vs conjunctival autograft vs amniotic membrane choices, and the mitomycin C debate.

episodes.title: Eyelid Anatomy: The Levator, Orbicularis, and Canthal Tendons
episodes.description: The lid anatomy relevant to ptosis and entropion, the levator function measurement, and the surgical landmarks.

episodes.title: Chalazion and Hordeolum: Medical vs Incision and Drainage
episodes.description: The internal vs external hordeolum, the warm compress and antibiotic protocol, and when I&D and intralesional steroid are indicated.

episodes.title: Blepharitis: Anterior Staphylococcal vs Posterior Meibomian Gland Dysfunction
episodes.description: The anterior vs posterior blepharitis distinction, the collarettes vs foam sign, and the lid hygiene and antibiotic protocol.

episodes.title: Entropion and Ectropion: The Involutional Lid Malalignments
episodes.description: The lower-lid laxity assessment (snapback, distraction), the involutional entropion and ectropion mechanisms, and the surgical referral.

episodes.title: Ptosis: Levator Function, MRD1, and the Surgical Decision
episodes.description: The MRD1 and levator function measurements, the congenital vs acquired ptosis, and the frontalis sling vs levator advancement selection.

episodes.title: Trichiasis and Distichiasis: Epilation, Electrolysis, and Cryotherapy
episodes.description: Distinguishing trichiasis (misdirected lashes) from distichiasis (extra row), and the stepwise treatment from epilation to cryotherapy.

episodes.title: Floppy Eyelid Syndrome: The Sleep Apnoea Connection
episodes.description: The easily everted upper lid, the rubbery tarsus, and the sleep apnoea workup and the shield and taping management.

episodes.title: Lacrimal System: Epiphora, Dacryocystitis, and the Jones Tests
episodes.description: The Jones I and II dye tests, the acute dacryocystitis antibiotic protocol, and when to refer for dacryocystorhinostomy.
